verses.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר יְהוָה֙ אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֔ה פְּסָל־ לְךָ֛ שְׁנֵֽי־ לֻחֹ֥ת אֲבָנִ֖ים כָּרִאשֹׁנִ֑ים וְכָתַבְתִּי֙ עַל־ הַלֻּחֹ֔ת אֶת־ הַדְּבָרִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר הָי֛וּ עַל־ הַלֻּחֹ֥ת הָרִאשֹׁנִ֖ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר שִׁבַּֽרְתָּ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer Yah·weh ’el- mō·šeh pə·sāl- lə·ḵā šə·nê- lu·ḥōṯ ’ă·ḇā·nîm kā·ri·šō·nîm wə·ḵā·ṯaḇ·tî ‘al- hal·lu·ḥōṯ ’eṯ- had·də·ḇā·rîm ’ă·šer hā·yū ‘al- hal·lu·ḥōṯ hā·ri·šō·nîm ’ă·šer šib·bar·tā
verses.literal: Then the LORD said to Moses Chisel out two stone tablets like the originals and I will write on them the words that were on the first tablets which you broke

verses.original: וֶהְיֵ֥ה נָכ֖וֹן לַבֹּ֑קֶר וְעָלִ֤יתָ בַבֹּ֙קֶר֙ אֶל־ הַ֣ר סִינַ֔י וְנִצַּבְתָּ֥ לִ֛י שָׁ֖ם עַל־ רֹ֥אשׁ הָהָֽר׃
verses.transliteration: weh·yêh nā·ḵō·wn lab·bō·qer wə·‘ā·lî·ṯā ḇab·bō·qer ’el- har sî·nay wə·niṣ·ṣaḇ·tā lî šām ‘al- rōš hā·hār
verses.literal: Be ready in the morning and come up on Mount Sinai . . . to present yourself before Me . . . on the mountaintop . . .

verses.original: וְאִישׁ֙ לֹֽא־ יַעֲלֶ֣ה עִמָּ֔ךְ וְגַם־ אִ֥ישׁ אַל־ יֵרָ֖א בְּכָל־ הָהָ֑ר גַּם־ הַצֹּ֤אן וְהַבָּקָר֙ אַל־ יִרְע֔וּ אֶל־ מ֖וּל הָהָ֥ר הַהֽוּא׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’îš lō- ya·‘ă·leh ‘im·māḵ wə·ḡam- ’îš ’al- yê·rā bə·ḵāl hā·hār gam- haṣ·ṣōn wə·hab·bā·qār ’al- yir·‘ū ’el- mūl hā·hār ha·hū
verses.literal: No one may go up with you in fact no one may be seen anywhere on the mountain not even the flocks or herds may graze in front of . . . the mountain

verses.original: וַיִּפְסֹ֡ל שְׁנֵֽי־ לֻחֹ֨ת אֲבָנִ֜ים כָּרִאשֹׁנִ֗ים וַיַּשְׁכֵּ֨ם מֹשֶׁ֤ה בַבֹּ֙קֶר֙ וַיַּ֙עַל֙ אֶל־ הַ֣ר סִינַ֔י כַּאֲשֶׁ֛ר צִוָּ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה אֹת֑וֹ וַיִּקַּ֣ח בְּיָד֔וֹ שְׁנֵ֖י לֻחֹ֥ת אֲבָנִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: way·yip̄·sōl šə·nê- lu·ḥōṯ ’ă·ḇā·nîm kā·ri·šō·nîm way·yaš·kêm mō·šeh ḇab·bō·qer way·ya·‘al ’el- har sî·nay ka·’ă·šer ṣiw·wāh Yah·weh ’ō·ṯōw way·yiq·qaḥ bə·yā·ḏōw šə·nê lu·ḥōṯ ’ă·ḇā·nîm
verses.literal: So Moses chiseled out two stone tablets like the originals He rose early in the morning and taking the two stone tablets in his hands he went up . . . Mount Sinai as the LORD had commanded him

verses.original: וַיֵּ֤רֶד יְהוָה֙ בֶּֽעָנָ֔ן וַיִּתְיַצֵּ֥ב עִמּ֖וֹ שָׁ֑ם וַיִּקְרָ֥א בְשֵׁ֖ם יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yê·reḏ Yah·weh be·‘ā·nān way·yiṯ·yaṣ·ṣêḇ ‘im·mōw šām way·yiq·rā ḇə·šêm Yah·weh
verses.literal: And the LORD descended in a cloud stood with him there and proclaimed His name the LORD

verses.original: וַיַּעֲבֹ֨ר יְהוָ֥ה׀ עַל־ פָּנָיו֮ וַיִּקְרָא֒ יְהוָ֣ה׀ יְהוָ֔ה אֵ֥ל רַח֖וּם וְחַנּ֑וּן אֶ֥רֶךְ אַפַּ֖יִם וְרַב־ חֶ֥סֶד וֶאֱמֶֽת׀
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘ă·ḇōr Yah·weh ‘al- pā·nāw way·yiq·rā Yah·weh Yah·weh ’êl ra·ḥūm wə·ḥan·nūn ’e·reḵ ’ap·pa·yim wə·raḇ- ḥe·seḏ wɛ·ʾɛ̆·mɛṯ
verses.literal: Then the LORD passed in front of Moses and called out The LORD the LORD God is compassionate and gracious slow to anger abounding in loving devotion and faithfulness

verses.original: נֹצֵ֥ר חֶ֙סֶד֙ לָאֲלָפִ֔ים נֹשֵׂ֥א עָוֺ֛ן וָפֶ֖שַׁע וְחַטָּאָ֑ה וְנַקֵּה֙ לֹ֣א יְנַקֶּ֔ה פֹּקֵ֣ד׀ עֲוֺ֣ן אָב֗וֹת עַל־ בָּנִים֙ וְעַל־ בְּנֵ֣י בָנִ֔ים עַל־ שִׁלֵּשִׁ֖ים וְעַל־ רִבֵּעִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: nō·ṣêr ḥe·seḏ lā·’ă·lā·p̄îm nō·śê ‘ā·wōn wā·p̄e·ša‘ wə·ḥaṭ·ṭā·’āh wə·naq·qêh lō yə·naq·qeh pō·qêḏ ‘ă·wōn ’ā·ḇō·wṯ ‘al- bā·nîm wə·‘al- bə·nê ḇā·nîm ‘al- šil·lê·šîm wə·‘al- rib·bê·‘îm
verses.literal: maintaining loving devotion to a thousand generations forgiving iniquity transgression and sin Yet He will by no means leave the guilty unpunished He will visit the iniquity of the fathers on their children and grandchildren . . . to the third . . . and fourth generations

verses.original: וַיְמַהֵ֖ר מֹשֶׁ֑ה וַיִּקֹּ֥ד אַ֖רְצָה וַיִּשְׁתָּֽחוּ׃
verses.transliteration: way·ma·hêr mō·šeh way·yiq·qōḏ ’ar·ṣāh way·yiš·tā·ḥū
verses.literal: Moses immediately bowed down to the ground and worshiped

verses.original: וַיֹּ֡אמֶר אִם־ נָא֩ מָצָ֨אתִי חֵ֤ן בְּעֵינֶ֙יךָ֙ אֲדֹנָ֔י יֵֽלֶךְ־ נָ֥א אֲדֹנָ֖י בְּקִרְבֵּ֑נוּ כִּ֤י עַם־ קְשֵׁה־ עֹ֙רֶף֙ ה֔וּא וְסָלַחְתָּ֛ לַעֲוֺנֵ֥נוּ וּלְחַטָּאתֵ֖נוּ וּנְחַלְתָּֽנוּ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer ’im- nā mā·ṣā·ṯî ḥên bə·‘ê·ne·ḵā ’ă·ḏō·nāy yê·leḵ- nā ’ă·ḏō·nāy bə·qir·bê·nū kî ‘am- qə·šêh- ‘ō·rep̄ hū wə·sā·laḥ·tā la·‘ă·wō·nê·nū ū·lə·ḥaṭ·ṭā·ṯê·nū ū·nə·ḥal·tā·nū
verses.literal: O Lord he said if I have indeed found favor in Your sight my Lord please go . . . with us Although this is a stiff-necked . . . people forgive our iniquity and sin and take us as Your inheritance

verses.original: וַיֹּ֗אמֶר הִנֵּ֣ה אָנֹכִי֮ כֹּרֵ֣ת בְּרִית֒ נֶ֤גֶד כָּֽל־ עַמְּךָ֙ אֶעֱשֶׂ֣ה נִפְלָאֹ֔ת אֲשֶׁ֛ר לֹֽא־ נִבְרְא֥וּ בְכָל־ הָאָ֖רֶץ וּבְכָל־ הַגּוֹיִ֑ם וְרָאָ֣ה כָל־ הָ֠עָם אֲשֶׁר־ אַתָּ֨ה בְקִרְבּ֜וֹ אֶת־ מַעֲשֵׂ֤ה יְהוָה֙ כִּֽי־ נוֹרָ֣א ה֔וּא אֲשֶׁ֥ר אֲנִ֖י עֹשֶׂ֥ה עִמָּֽךְ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer hin·nêh ’ā·nō·ḵî kō·rêṯ bə·rîṯ ne·ḡeḏ kāl- ‘am·mə·ḵā ’e·‘ĕ·śeh nip̄·lā·’ōṯ ’ă·šer lō- niḇ·rə·’ū ḇə·ḵāl- hā·’ā·reṣ ū·ḇə·ḵāl hag·gō·w·yim wə·rā·’āh ḵāl hā·‘ām ’ă·šer- ’at·tāh ḇə·qir·bōw ’eṯ- ma·‘ă·śêh Yah·weh kî- nō·w·rā hū ’ă·šer ’ă·nî ‘ō·śeh ‘im·māḵ
verses.literal: And the LORD said Behold I am making a covenant Before all your people I will perform wonders that have never been done in any nation in all the world All the people among whom you live - will see the LORD’s work for it is an awesome thing that I am doing with you

verses.original: שְׁמָ֨ר־ לְךָ֔ אֵ֛ת אֲשֶׁ֥ר אָנֹכִ֖י מְצַוְּךָ֣ הַיּ֑וֹם הִנְנִ֧י גֹרֵ֣שׁ מִפָּנֶ֗יךָ אֶת־ הָאֱמֹרִי֙ וְהַֽכְּנַעֲנִ֔י וְהַחִתִּי֙ וְהַפְּרִזִּ֔י וְהַחִוִּ֖י וְהַיְבוּסִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: šə·mār- lə·ḵā ’êṯ ’ă·šer ’ā·nō·ḵî mə·ṣaw·wə·ḵā hay·yō·wm hin·nî ḡō·rêš mip·pā·ne·ḵā ’eṯ- hā·’ĕ·mō·rî wə·hak·kə·na·‘ă·nî wə·ha·ḥit·tî wə·hap·pə·riz·zî wə·ha·ḥiw·wî wə·hay·ḇū·sî
verses.literal: Observe what I command you this day . . . I will drive out before you the Amorites Canaanites Hittites Perizzites Hivites and Jebusites

verses.original: הִשָּׁ֣מֶר לְךָ֗ פֶּן־ תִּכְרֹ֤ת בְּרִית֙ לְיוֹשֵׁ֣ב הָאָ֔רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֥ר אַתָּ֖ה בָּ֣א עָלֶ֑יהָ פֶּן־ יִהְיֶ֥ה לְמוֹקֵ֖שׁ בְּקִרְבֶּֽךָ׃
verses.transliteration: hiš·šā·mer lə·ḵā pen- tiḵ·rōṯ bə·rîṯ lə·yō·wō·šêḇ hā·’ā·reṣ ’ă·šer ’at·tāh bā ‘ā·le·hā pen- yih·yeh lə·mō·w·qêš bə·qir·be·ḵā
verses.literal: Be careful not to make a treaty with the inhabitants of the land you are entering . . . lest they become a snare in your midst

verses.original: כִּ֤י אֶת־ מִזְבְּחֹתָם֙ תִּתֹּצ֔וּן וְאֶת־ מַצֵּבֹתָ֖ם תְּשַׁבֵּר֑וּן וְאֶת־ אֲשֵׁרָ֖יו תִּכְרֹתֽוּן׃
verses.transliteration: kî ’eṯ- miz·bə·ḥō·ṯām tit·tō·ṣūn wə·’eṯ- maṣ·ṣê·ḇō·ṯām tə·šab·bê·rūn wə·’eṯ- ’ă·šê·rāw tiḵ·rō·ṯūn
verses.literal: Rather you must tear down their altars smash their sacred stones and chop down their Asherah poles

verses.original: כִּ֛י לֹ֥א תִֽשְׁתַּחֲוֶ֖ה לְאֵ֣ל אַחֵ֑ר כִּ֤י יְהוָה֙ קַנָּ֣א שְׁמ֔וֹ אֵ֥ל קַנָּ֖א הֽוּא׃
verses.transliteration: kî lō ṯiš·ta·ḥă·weh lə·’êl ’a·ḥêr kî Yah·weh qan·nā šə·mōw ’êl qan·nā hū
verses.literal: For you must not worship any other god for the LORD whose name is Jealous is a jealous . . . God

verses.original: פֶּן־ תִּכְרֹ֥ת בְּרִ֖ית לְיוֹשֵׁ֣ב הָאָ֑רֶץ וְזָנ֣וּ׀ אַחֲרֵ֣י אֱלֹֽהֵיהֶ֗ם וְזָבְחוּ֙ לֵאלֹ֣הֵיהֶ֔ם וְקָרָ֣א לְךָ֔ וְאָכַלְתָּ֖ מִזִּבְחֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: pen- tiḵ·rōṯ bə·rîṯ lə·yō·wō·šêḇ hā·’ā·reṣ wə·zā·nū ’a·ḥă·rê ’ĕ·lō·hê·hem wə·zā·ḇə·ḥū lê·lō·hê·hem wə·qā·rā lə·ḵā wə·’ā·ḵal·tā miz·ziḇ·ḥōw
verses.literal: Do not make a covenant with the inhabitants of the land for when they prostitute themselves to their gods and sacrifice to them they will invite you and you will eat their sacrifices

verses.original: וְלָקַחְתָּ֥ מִבְּנֹתָ֖יו לְבָנֶ֑יךָ וְזָנ֣וּ בְנֹתָ֗יו אַחֲרֵי֙ אֱלֹ֣הֵיהֶ֔ן וְהִזְנוּ֙ אֶת־ בָּנֶ֔יךָ אַחֲרֵ֖י אֱלֹהֵיהֶֽן׃
verses.transliteration: wə·lā·qaḥ·tā mib·bə·nō·ṯāw lə·ḇā·ne·ḵā wə·zā·nū ḇə·nō·ṯāw ’a·ḥă·rê ’ĕ·lō·hê·hen wə·hiz·nū ’eṯ- bā·ne·ḵā ’a·ḥă·rê ’ĕ·lō·hê·hen
verses.literal: And when you take some of their daughters as brides for your sons their daughters will prostitute themselves to their gods and cause your sons to do the same - . . .

verses.original: אֱלֹהֵ֥י מַסֵּכָ֖ה לֹ֥א תַעֲשֶׂה־ לָּֽךְ׃
verses.transliteration: ’ĕ·lō·hê mas·sê·ḵāh lō ṯa·‘ă·śeh- lāḵ
verses.literal: You shall make no molten gods for yourselves

verses.original: אֶת־ חַ֣ג הַמַּצּוֹת֮ תִּשְׁמֹר֒ שִׁבְעַ֨ת יָמִ֜ים תֹּאכַ֤ל מַצּוֹת֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר צִוִּיתִ֔ךָ לְמוֹעֵ֖ד חֹ֣דֶשׁ הָאָבִ֑יב כִּ֚י בְּחֹ֣דֶשׁ הָֽאָבִ֔יב יָצָ֖אתָ מִמִּצְרָֽיִם׃
verses.transliteration: ’eṯ- ḥaḡ ham·maṣ·ṣō·wṯ tiš·mōr šiḇ·‘aṯ yā·mîm tō·ḵal maṣ·ṣō·wṯ ’ă·šer ṣiw·wî·ṯi·ḵā lə·mō·w·‘êḏ ḥō·ḏeš hā·’ā·ḇîḇ kî bə·ḥō·ḏeš hā·’ā·ḇîḇ yā·ṣā·ṯā mim·miṣ·rā·yim
verses.literal: You are to keep the Feast of Unleavened Bread For seven days at the appointed time in the month of Abib you are to eat unleavened bread as I commanded you For in the month of Abib you came out of Egypt

verses.original: כָּל־ פֶּ֥טֶר רֶ֖חֶם לִ֑י וְכָֽל־ מִקְנְךָ֙ תִּזָּכָ֔ר פֶּ֖טֶר שׁ֥וֹר וָשֶֽׂה׃
verses.transliteration: kāl- pe·ṭer re·ḥem lî wə·ḵāl miq·nə·ḵā tiz·zā·ḵār pe·ṭer šō·wr wā·śeh
verses.literal: The first offspring of every womb belongs to Me including all the firstborn males among your livestock whether cattle or sheep

verses.original: וּפֶ֤טֶר חֲמוֹר֙ תִּפְדֶּ֣ה בְשֶׂ֔ה וְאִם־ לֹ֥א תִפְדֶּ֖ה וַעֲרַפְתּ֑וֹ כֹּ֣ל בְּכ֤וֹר בָּנֶ֙יךָ֙ תִּפְדֶּ֔ה וְלֹֽא־ יֵרָא֥וּ פָנַ֖י רֵיקָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ū·p̄e·ṭer ḥă·mō·wr tip̄·deh ḇə·śeh wə·’im- lō ṯip̄·deh wa·‘ă·rap̄·tōw kōl bə·ḵō·wr bā·ne·ḵā tip̄·deh wə·lō- yê·rā·’ū p̄ā·nay rê·qām
verses.literal: You must redeem the firstborn of a donkey with a lamb but if you do not redeem it you are to break its neck You must redeem all the firstborn of your sons No one shall appear before Me empty-handed

verses.original: שֵׁ֤שֶׁת יָמִים֙ תַּעֲבֹ֔ד וּבַיּ֥וֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִ֖י תִּשְׁבֹּ֑ת בֶּחָרִ֥ישׁ וּבַקָּצִ֖יר תִּשְׁבֹּֽת׃
verses.transliteration: šê·šeṯ yā·mîm ta·‘ă·ḇōḏ ū·ḇay·yō·wm haš·šə·ḇî·‘î tiš·bōṯ be·ḥā·rîš ū·ḇaq·qā·ṣîr tiš·bōṯ
verses.literal: Six days you shall labor but on the seventh day you shall rest even in the seasons of plowing and harvesting you must rest

verses.original: וְחַ֤ג שָׁבֻעֹת֙ תַּעֲשֶׂ֣ה לְךָ֔ בִּכּוּרֵ֖י קְצִ֣יר חִטִּ֑ים וְחַג֙ הָֽאָסִ֔יף תְּקוּפַ֖ת הַשָּׁנָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḥaḡ šā·ḇu·‘ōṯ ta·‘ă·śeh lə·ḵā bik·kū·rê qə·ṣîr ḥiṭ·ṭîm wə·ḥaḡ hā·’ā·sîp̄ tə·qū·p̄aṯ haš·šā·nāh
verses.literal: And you are to celebrate the Feast of Weeks with the firstfruits of the wheat harvest and the Feast of Ingathering at the turn of the year

verses.original: שָׁלֹ֥שׁ פְּעָמִ֖ים בַּשָּׁנָ֑ה יֵרָאֶה֙ כָּל־ זְכ֣וּרְךָ֔ אֶת־ פְּנֵ֛י הָֽאָדֹ֥ן׀ יְהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: šā·lōš pə·‘ā·mîm baš·šā·nāh yê·rā·’eh kāl- zə·ḵū·rə·ḵā ’eṯ- pə·nê hā·’ā·ḏōn Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: Three times a year all your males . . . are to appear before the Lord GOD the God of Israel

verses.original: כִּֽי־ אוֹרִ֤ישׁ גּוֹיִם֙ מִפָּנֶ֔יךָ וְהִרְחַבְתִּ֖י אֶת־ גְּבוּלֶ֑ךָ וְלֹא־ יַחְמֹ֥ד אִישׁ֙ אֶֽת־ אַרְצְךָ֔ בַּעֲלֹֽתְךָ֗ לֵרָאוֹת֙ אֶת־ פְּנֵי֙ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔יךָ שָׁלֹ֥שׁ פְּעָמִ֖ים בַּשָּׁנָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: kî- ’ō·w·rîš gō·w·yim mip·pā·ne·ḵā wə·hir·ḥaḇ·tî ’eṯ- gə·ḇū·le·ḵā wə·lō- yaḥ·mōḏ ’îš ’eṯ- ’ar·ṣə·ḵā ba·‘ă·lō·ṯə·ḵā lê·rā·’ō·wṯ ’eṯ- pə·nê Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā šā·lōš pə·‘ā·mîm baš·šā·nāh
verses.literal: For I will drive out the nations before you and enlarge your borders and no one will covet your land when you go up three times a year to appear before the LORD your God

verses.original: לֹֽא־ תִשְׁחַ֥ט עַל־ חָמֵ֖ץ דַּם־ זִבְחִ֑י וְלֹא־ יָלִ֣ין לַבֹּ֔קֶר זֶ֖בַח חַ֥ג הַפָּֽסַח׃
verses.transliteration: lō- ṯiš·ḥaṭ ‘al- ḥā·mêṣ dam- ziḇ·ḥî wə·lō- yā·lîn lab·bō·qer ze·ḇaḥ ḥaḡ hap·pā·saḥ
verses.literal: Do not offer the blood of a sacrifice to Me along with anything leavened and do not let any of the sacrifice from the Passover Feast remain until morning

verses.original: רֵאשִׁ֗ית בִּכּוּרֵי֙ אַדְמָ֣תְךָ֔ תָּבִ֕יא בֵּ֖ית יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֑יךָ לֹא־ תְבַשֵּׁ֥ל גְּדִ֖י בַּחֲלֵ֥ב אִמּֽוֹ׃פ
verses.transliteration: rê·šîṯ bik·kū·rê ’aḏ·mā·ṯə·ḵā tā·ḇî bêṯ Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā lō- ṯə·ḇaš·šêl gə·ḏî ba·ḥă·lêḇ ’im·mōw
verses.literal: Bring the best of the firstfruits of your soil to the house of the LORD your God You must not cook a young goat in its mother’s milk

verses.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר יְהוָה֙ אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֔ה כְּתָב־ לְךָ֖ אֶת־ הַדְּבָרִ֣ים הָאֵ֑לֶּה כִּ֞י עַל־ פִּ֣י׀ הַדְּבָרִ֣ים הָאֵ֗לֶּה כָּרַ֧תִּי אִתְּךָ֛ בְּרִ֖ית וְאֶת־ יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer Yah·weh ’el- mō·šeh kə·ṯāḇ- lə·ḵā ’eṯ- had·də·ḇā·rîm hā·’êl·leh kî ‘al- pî had·də·ḇā·rîm hā·’êl·leh kā·rat·tî ’it·tə·ḵā bə·rîṯ wə·’eṯ- yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: The LORD also said to Moses Write down these words for in accordance with . . . these words I have made a covenant with you and with Israel

verses.original: וַֽיְהִי־ שָׁ֣ם עִם־ יְהוָ֗ה אַרְבָּעִ֥ים יוֹם֙ וְאַרְבָּעִ֣ים לַ֔יְלָה לֶ֚חֶם לֹ֣א אָכַ֔ל וּמַ֖יִם לֹ֣א שָׁתָ֑ה וַיִּכְתֹּ֣ב עַל־ הַלֻּחֹ֗ת אֵ֚ת דִּבְרֵ֣י הַבְּרִ֔ית עֲשֶׂ֖רֶת הַדְּבָרִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî- šām ‘im- Yah·weh ’ar·bā·‘îm yō·wm wə·’ar·bā·‘îm lay·lāh le·ḥem lō ’ā·ḵal ū·ma·yim lō šā·ṯāh way·yiḵ·tōḇ ‘al- hal·lu·ḥōṯ ’êṯ diḇ·rê hab·bə·rîṯ ‘ă·śe·reṯ had·də·ḇā·rîm
verses.literal: So Moses was there with the LORD forty days and forty nights without eating bread or drinking . . . . . . water He wrote on the tablets the words of the covenant the Ten Commandments

verses.original: וַיְהִ֗י בְּרֶ֤דֶת מֹשֶׁה֙ מֵהַ֣ר סִינַ֔י וּשְׁנֵ֨י לֻחֹ֤ת הָֽעֵדֻת֙ בְּיַד־ מֹשֶׁ֔ה בְּרִדְתּ֖וֹ מִן־ הָהָ֑ר וּמֹשֶׁ֣ה לֹֽא־ יָדַ֗ע כִּ֥י קָרַ֛ן ע֥וֹר פָּנָ֖יו בְּדַבְּר֥וֹ אִתּֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî bə·re·ḏeṯ mō·šeh mê·har sî·nay ū·šə·nê lu·ḥōṯ hā·‘ê·ḏuṯ bə·yaḏ- mō·šeh bə·riḏ·tōw min- hā·hār ū·mō·šeh lō- yā·ḏa‘ kî qā·ran ‘ō·wr pā·nāw bə·ḏab·bə·rōw ’it·tōw
verses.literal: And when Moses came down from Mount Sinai with the two tablets of the Testimony in his hands - he was unaware that his face had become radiant from speaking with the LORD

verses.original: וַיַּ֨רְא אַהֲרֹ֜ן וְכָל־ בְּנֵ֤י יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ אֶת־ מֹשֶׁ֔ה וְהִנֵּ֥ה קָרַ֖ן ע֣וֹר פָּנָ֑יו וַיִּֽירְא֖וּ מִגֶּ֥שֶׁת אֵלָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: way·yar ’a·hă·rōn wə·ḵāl bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl ’eṯ- mō·šeh wə·hin·nêh qā·ran ‘ō·wr pā·nāw way·yî·rə·’ū mig·ge·šeṯ ’ê·lāw
verses.literal: Aaron and all the Israelites . . . looked at Moses and behold his face was radiant And they were afraid to approach him

verses.original: וַיִּקְרָ֤א אֲלֵהֶם֙ מֹשֶׁ֔ה וַיָּשֻׁ֧בוּ אֵלָ֛יו אַהֲרֹ֥ן וְכָל־ הַנְּשִׂאִ֖ים בָּעֵדָ֑ה וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר מֹשֶׁ֖ה אֲלֵהֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiq·rā ’ă·lê·hem mō·šeh way·yā·šu·ḇū ’ê·lāw ’a·hă·rōn wə·ḵāl han·nə·śi·’îm bā·‘ê·ḏāh way·ḏab·bêr mō·šeh ’ă·lê·hem
verses.literal: But Moses called out to them so Aaron and all the leaders of the congregation returned to him and Moses spoke to them

verses.original: וְאַחֲרֵי־ כֵ֥ן נִגְּשׁ֖וּ כָּל־ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַיְצַוֵּ֕ם אֵת֩ כָּל־ אֲשֶׁ֨ר דִּבֶּ֧ר יְהוָ֛ה אִתּ֖וֹ בְּהַ֥ר סִינָֽי׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’a·ḥă·rê- ḵên nig·gə·šū kāl- bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl way·ṣaw·wêm ’êṯ kāl- ’ă·šer dib·ber Yah·weh ’it·tōw bə·har sî·nāy
verses.literal: And after this all the Israelites . . . came near and Moses commanded them to do everything that the LORD . . . had told him on Mount Sinai

verses.original: וַיְכַ֣ל מֹשֶׁ֔ה מִדַּבֵּ֖ר אִתָּ֑ם וַיִּתֵּ֥ן עַל־ פָּנָ֖יו מַסְוֶֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·ḵal mō·šeh mid·dab·bêr ’it·tām way·yit·tên ‘al- pā·nāw mas·weh
verses.literal: When Moses had finished speaking with them he put a veil over his face

verses.original: וּבְבֹ֨א מֹשֶׁ֜ה לִפְנֵ֤י יְהוָה֙ לְדַבֵּ֣ר אִתּ֔וֹ יָסִ֥יר אֶת־ הַמַּסְוֶ֖ה עַד־ צֵאת֑וֹ וְיָצָ֗א וְדִבֶּר֙ אֶל־ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אֵ֖ת אֲשֶׁ֥ר יְצֻוֶּֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇə·ḇō mō·šeh lip̄·nê Yah·weh lə·ḏab·bêr ’it·tōw yā·sîr ’eṯ- ham·mas·weh ‘aḏ- ṣê·ṯōw wə·yā·ṣā wə·ḏib·ber ’el- bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl ’êṯ ’ă·šer yə·ṣuw·weh
verses.literal: But whenever Moses went in before the LORD to speak with Him he would remove the veil until he came out And when he came out he would tell . . . the Israelites . . . what he had been commanded

verses.original: וְרָא֤וּ בְנֵֽי־ יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ אֶת־ פְּנֵ֣י מֹשֶׁ֔ה כִּ֣י קָרַ֔ן ע֖וֹר פְּנֵ֣י מֹשֶׁ֑ה וְהֵשִׁ֨יב מֹשֶׁ֤ה אֶת־ הַמַּסְוֶה֙ עַל־ פָּנָ֔יו עַד־ בֹּא֖וֹ לְדַבֵּ֥ר אִתּֽוֹ׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·rā·’ū ḇə·nê- yiś·rā·’êl ’eṯ- pə·nê mō·šeh kî qā·ran ‘ō·wr pə·nê mō·šeh wə·hê·šîḇ mō·šeh ’eṯ- ham·mas·weh ‘al- pā·nāw ‘aḏ- bō·’ōw lə·ḏab·bêr ’it·tōw
verses.literal: and the Israelites . . . would see that the face of Moses was radiant . . . So Moses would put the veil back over . . . his face . . . until he went in to speak with the LORD
